title: Inflation falls to 3.3% in February, lowest since 2021 rebasing
desc: Ghana's inflation rate fell further to 3.3 per cent in February 2026, down from 3.8 per cent in January and a dramatic decline from 23.1 per cent recorded in the same month last year, the Ghana Statistical Service (GSS) has announced. The latest Consumer Price Index (CPI) data, released by the GSS, shows the country's general price level continues to ease, offering some relief to Ghanaian households who have endured years of high living costs.

title: A City Under Construction, A Profession in Transition
desc:
When Baron Georges-Eugène Haussmann redesigned Paris in the 19th century, photographers followed the boulevards.
Today, Addis Ababa’s corridor and riverside rehabilitation projects are producing a similar effect. Revitalized public spaces, from palace grounds to Friendship Park, have turned beautified infrastructure into commercial backdrops.
Photographers are licensing through local administrations, financing their own equipment, and serving a growing demand for instant, outdoor imagery.
